registryEntry.label: Verify every past leaver (employeeLeaveDateTime passed) is disabled and holds no licence
registryEntry.get_command: & { $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $u=@(@((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/users?`$filter=employeeLeaveDateTime le $now&`$select=id,userPrincipalName,accountEnabled,employeeLeaveDateTime,assignedLicenses&`$top=999").value) | Where-Object { $_ }); $open=@($u | Where-Object { $_.accountEnabled -eq $true }); $lic=@($u | Where-Object { @($_.assignedLicenses | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0 }); [pscustomobject]@{ displayName='CES leaver access inventory'; pastLeaverCount=$u.Count; enabledPastLeaverCount=$open.Count; licensedPastLeaverCount=$lic.Count; enabledPastLeavers=@($open | ForEach-Object { $_.userPrincipalName }); licensedPastLeavers=@($lic | ForEach-Object { $_.userPrincipalName }) } } | Where-Object { ($_.displayName -eq 'CES leaver access inventory') -or (($null -ne $_.pastLeaverCount -and [double]$_.pastLeaverCount -ge 1) -and ($null -ne $_.enabledPastLeaverCount -and [double]$_.enabledPastLeaverCount -le 0) -and ($null -ne $_.licensedPastLeaverCount -and [double]$_.licensedPastLeaverCount -le 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.displayName -ne 'CES leaver access inventory' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
